correctedState: The runtime substitutes an empty object at BOTH invocation chokepoints, not one: the tool's own run (`compiledScript(makeApi(input.args ?? {}))`, workflow-tool.ts:750) and the in-script nested-workflow helper (`compileWorkflowScript(source)(makeApi(recipeArgs ?? {}))`, workflow-tool.ts:660). normalizeInput (:186) leaves an omitted `args` as undefined and the sandbox does not default it (sandbox.ts:277-300 injects api.args verbatim as the `args` Function parameter), so the coalescing is the sole cause. Measured: with args omitted a script sees `typeof args === 'object'`, `args === undefined` false, `!args` false and `args ?? default` evaluating to `{}`; the same script with the value passed through sees `undefined`, true, true and the default. A script that branches on `args === undefined`/`!args`/`args ?? d` to supply defaults therefore never takes that branch. Applies to saved (`name`) and plugin (`scriptPath`) workflows alike, since both resolve into the same line 750.
